description: Shake an iOS simulator or an Android emulator once. iOS posts the shake notification that Device > Shake in the Simulator app posts, which UIKit delivers to the app as a motion-shake event; it injects no accelerometer data, so an app that detects shakes through CoreMotion does not see it. Android swings the emulator's accelerometer about 2 g in alternating directions for about a second through the emulator console, then restores the reading it found, so an app that counts direction changes above a force threshold sees a shake. The shake is sent without activating the session app and nothing is re-observed afterwards, so take a snapshot to see what the app did with it. Physical devices, Android TV, remote provider devices, and every other platform refuse this command. Times out after 90s.

device.description: Device name; ids go in udid or serial.

serial.description: Android, HarmonyOS, or Vega VVD serial.
